label: Qualification needed for undergraduate entry
value: Queensland Year 12 or an equivalent qualification, plus the program's minimum entry score; no India-specific percentage is published as text
passage: To be offered a place in an undergraduate program, you need to have successfully completed Queensland Year 12, or a qualification equivalent to Queensland Year 12, with the required minimum entry score for the program you're interested in studying.
notes: India-specific (CBSE/ISC) scores appear only via a JavaScript qualification selector on program pages; not quotable.

label: English requirement (most programs)
value: IELTS overall 6.5 with 6.0 in all sub-bands, or equivalent
passage: To be eligible for entry to most UQ programs, you need to meet our minimum English language requirements (overall IELTS of 6.5 and 6.0 in all sub-bands or equivalent, including IELTS One Skill Retake).
notes: Some programs differ. Same page: 'IELTS Online is not recognised by UQ.'

label: Master of Computer Science (5522): minimum GPA
value: GPA of 5.0 on UQ's 7-point scale in the previous qualification
passage: You must have a grade point average (GPA) of 5.0 on a 7-point scale in your previous qualification
notes: Program-specific, not India-specific. The Indian-degree GPA equivalent is shown only through a JavaScript selector. General PG page: 'For most programs, you'll need to have completed an approved degree equivalent to an Australian bachelor's degree.'

How international students apply
value: Apply directly from the course page or via an authorised agent, and pay the application processing fee
passage: Apply directly to the University from your course page or via an authorised agent . Note that you’ll need to pay the application processing fee .
notes: Applicants currently studying Australian Year 12 or an IB diploma in Australia apply through UAC instead.

label: After the offer: Confirmation of Enrolment for the visa
value: Accept the offer, pay first-semester fees, then receive an eCoE for the student visa application
passage: You need to accept your offer by the deadline and pay your first semester fees to enrol. After payment, you’ll receive an electronic Confirmation of Enrolment (eCoE) for your student visa application.
